title: AnchorBaseline
description: Story 9-11: cross-evaluator anchor stability baseline. Persisted at evals/anchor_baselines/v{N}.json by benchmark.anchor_stability_audit. Re-used by benchmark.anchor_baselines.compare_against_current for Epic-10+ drift detection.

baseline_date.description: ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) the audit was run.

primary_evaluator.description: Model id used for the primary evaluator dispatch (typically Opus).

secondary_evaluator.description: Model id used for the cross-evaluator dispatch (typically Sonnet or DeepSeek-V3 via OpenRouter).

anchors_version.description: Anchors corpus version (mirrors evals/anchors/VERSION file content).

per_anchor_scores.description: Per-anchor primary + secondary scores. Sorted by anchor_id for diff-friendliness.

delta.description: abs(primary_score - secondary_score); always non-negative for diff-friendliness.

krippendorff_alpha.description: Ordinal-δ² Krippendorff α across primary + secondary on the 1-5 scale.

verdict.description: α ≥ 0.8 → trusted; 0.6 ≤ α < 0.8 → uncertain; α < 0.6 → untrusted (BLOCKS Epic 9 done-flip).
